title: The Investor Who Told William Tanuwijaya He Was Not Special
conflicts: First money: Victor Fungkong's Rp 2.4bn for 80 per cent (Good News From Indonesia, 2016) against Rp 2.5bn (Tempo, 403, not cited); a blog dates Indonusa's first investment to 2010, against February 2009 in AVCJ, Selular and GNFI; story uses February 2009 and gives Rp 2.4bn as 'one account'. The investor's put-down is worded differently in 2016, 2017 and 2021 tellings; story quotes the 2016 Bloomberg version with attribution. Eleven pitches is Bloomberg's figure only and is attributed.
notes: Company field is plain 'Tokopedia' because 'later GoTo' tripped the repeat screen against the Gojek edition. Bloomberg's own page and Tokopedia's Medium history return 403; Bloomberg text cited via Malay Mail's republication. Leontinus Alpha Edison's own part in the fundraising is thinly documented, so his role is brief. Quote stance: affirms.
